title: Foiled enrichment Fact
description: One piece of context a provider asserts about an observable (#11). Facts hang off observables and join to attempts (#25) through the observables an attempt carries. See docs/enrichment.md. Mirrors Fact in crates/core/src/enrichment.rs.

provider.description: Provider id from configs/enrichment.yaml, or yara for the YARA batch job. Facts from greynoise, crowdsec, dshield, shadowserver, huntio, abuseipdb and local_asn are never exported.

key.description: Dotted key namespaced by provider or topic, for example greynoise.noise, crowdsec.mitre_techniques or asn.number.

value.description: The asserted value. Provider text is untrusted, clipped to 256 characters and lists to 64 items.

confidence.description: The provider's own certainty. An input to the confidence layer (#27), never a final link score.

observed_at.description: Unix milliseconds when the provider was asked.

ttl_secs.description: Seconds after observed_at during which the Fact may be used.

raw_ref.description: Where the raw response or source object is kept (a cache row key or an r2:// reference). Never the response itself.
